name: Hoogstede (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hoogstede (a red cross and a bend of discs on yellow and red).
history: Municipal flag of Hoogstede; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hoogstede arms — cross and bend of discs
